# Physical & Life Sciences — Course Outline

**Faculty:** Faculty of Science  
**Path id:** `sci-physical-life`  
**Tier:** intermediate · **Annual school fees:** APW$ 675 (dual tender)  
**Audience:** Senior High

## Description

Integrate core physics, chemistry, and biology ideas through inquiry.

## Objectives

- Build Senior High competence aligned to the faculty mission.
- Complete each lesson card with a written practice response.
- Be ready to discuss ideas aloud in class mode.

## Lesson sequence

| # | Lesson | File |
|---|--------|------|
| 1 | Forces and Motion | `lessons/01-forces-motion.md` |
| 2 | Energy Systems | `lessons/02-energy-systems.md` |
| 3 | Particles and Reactions | `lessons/03-particles-reactions.md` |
| 4 | Cells to Systems | `lessons/04-cells-systems.md` |
| 5 | Inquiry Write-Up | `lessons/05-inquiry-writeup.md` |

## Assessment (v1)

Opening a lesson card and engaging the practice prompt counts as progress. Formal exams are out of scope for this content pack version.
